what: released google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch @ 43046b85 (the task's external target) replayed under the task contract by environment/reference/timesfm3_zero_shot with the official GIFT-Eval notebook's settings (input patch 32, output patch 64, variate attention, sorted quantiles); scored by evaluation/score.py against the leaderboard's Seasonal Naive normalizer and compared per config with the published CSV (Space @ a5019972)
protocol: task test split, all 97 configs, 326,490 instances, 16,384-observation context cap, targets only (no past covariates); run directly on the staged split by the maintainers (trusted code), not through the cohort-wise sealed verifier used for submissions
covariate_note: GIFT-Eval carries past_feat_dynamic_real on 10 dataset-frequency variants (24 of the 97 configs: bitbrains_fast_storage, bitbrains_rnd, bizitobs_application, bizitobs_service, bizitobs_l2c, M_DENSE); the official notebook forwards them and the task's case files do not, so this replay forecasts those configs from the target history alone. On the 73 configs without covariates it reproduces the published CSV to 0.2% (56 of the 73 within 1e-6; aggregate relative MASE 0.7120 / WQL 0.4796, identical to four decimals); on the 24 with covariates it is up to 6.9% (MASE) and 14.9% worse, which is the whole gap between the task reward 0.4465 and the board's 0.4488.

aggregate_vs_leaderboard_seasonal_naive.note: geometric mean over the 97 configs of (value / Seasonal_Naive value from results/seasonal_naive/all_results.csv)

package_settings.multivariate: native cross-variate attention, <=32 variates per forward pass
package_settings.nan_handling: passed through as NaN; the forecaster strips leading all-NaN steps and linearly interpolates the rest
package_settings.mean_forecast: the model's median quantile (TimesFM-3 has no separate mean head; the notebook's QuantileForecast also falls back to q0.5)
package_settings.per_core_batch_size_budget: TIMESFM3_TOKEN_BUDGET=245760 series*steps*variates (inner batch 16 at a 15360-step context; the notebook's 64/16 everywhere else)
package_settings.past_covariates: none (the task's case files carry targets only; the notebook forwards past_feat_dynamic_real where GIFT-Eval has it)
